```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r load-packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(modelr)

data("sim1", package = "modelr")
```

## Task 1: RMSE function for sim1

```{r task1}
rmse_sim1 <- function(b0, b1) {
  pred  <- b0 + b1 * sim1$x
  resid <- sim1$y - pred
  sqrt(mean(resid^2))
}

# Test: flat-zero model predicts 0 for all observations
cat("RMSE of flat-zero model:", round(rmse_sim1(0, 0), 3), "\n")
cat("RMSE at (0, 2):", round(rmse_sim1(0, 2), 3), "\n")
```

## Task 2: Grid search

```{r task2}
grid <- expand.grid(
  b0 = seq(-5, 20, length = 25),
  b1 = seq(1, 3, length = 25)
) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(rmse = map2_dbl(b0, b1, rmse_sim1))

best_grid <- grid |> slice_min(rmse, n = 1)
print(best_grid)
# b0 ≈ 4.17, b1 ≈ 2.08 — close but not exact due to grid coarseness
```

## Task 3: Numerical optimisation with optim()

```{r task3}
rmse_vec <- function(params) rmse_sim1(params[1], params[2])

res <- optim(c(0, 0), rmse_vec, method = "BFGS")
cat("optim() b0:", round(res$par[1], 4), "\n")
cat("optim() b1:", round(res$par[2], 4), "\n")
cat("optim() RMSE:", round(res$value, 4), "\n")
cat("Convergence code:", res$convergence,
    "(0 = success)\n")
```

## Task 4: Compare to lm()

```{r task4}
lm_fit <- lm(y ~ x, data = sim1)
lm_b   <- coef(lm_fit)

cat("\n--- Parameter comparison ---\n")
cat("Method       b0        b1\n")
cat("Grid search:", round(best_grid$b0, 3), "  ", round(best_grid$b1, 3), "\n")
cat("optim():    ", round(res$par[1],  3), "  ", round(res$par[2],  3), "\n")
cat("lm():       ", round(lm_b[1],    3), "  ", round(lm_b[2],    3), "\n")

# optim() matches lm() to 4+ decimal places.
# Grid search is close but limited by the coarseness of the 25x25 grid.
```

## Task 5: Visualise the grid search

```{r task5}
ggplot(grid, aes(x = b0, y = b1, colour = rmse)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  # Mark the optim() solution
  geom_point(
    data = tibble(b0 = res$par[1], b1 = res$par[2]),
    aes(x = b0, y = b1),
    colour = "red", size = 5, shape = 18, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c(name = "RMSE", option = "plasma") +
  labs(
    title    = "Grid search RMSE landscape — sim1",
    subtitle = "Red diamond = optim() solution (exact minimum). Low RMSE = dark colours.",
    x        = expression(beta[0] ~ "(intercept)"),
    y        = expression(beta[1] ~ "(slope)")
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# The low-RMSE region (dark) forms a diagonal valley — a direct visual
# of parameter correlation. optim() lands right in the deepest part.
```
